list.title: My Devices
list.subtitle: Manage the IoT devices linked to your account.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Device
deleteDialog.confirmPrefix: Are you sure you want to delete
deleteDialog.warning: This will permanently remove the device (ID: {{deviceId}}) from your account. This cannot be undone.
deleteDialog.confirmPlaceholder: Enter device name to confirm deletion.

telemetryHistory.title: Telemetry History
telemetryHistory.description: Recorded values for one field over time.
telemetryHistory.noData: No telemetry recorded in this time range.

addDialog.title: Add Device
addDialog.description: Choose a template and name your device, then scan its QR code.
addDialog.scanDescription: Scan the QR code printed on the physical device, or type its ID manually.
addDialog.configureDescription: Set the network parameters this device will fetch at boot, or skip and configure later.

actionsPanel.title: Actions
actionsPanel.description: Send a command to this device. Delivery is a live round-trip — the device must be online to receive it.
actionsPanel.channelUnsupported: Actions are unsupported for this device's push channel

configDialog.pushSent: Push sent — device will re-fetch config v{{version}}
configDialog.pushDisabledHint: Only KAFKA-push devices (gateways) can receive a config-sync push.
configDialog.title: Device Config
configDialog.description: Configure the network parameters this device fetches at boot.

configViewDialog.title: Device Config
configViewDialog.description: Current network parameters served from the boot-config endpoint.

lifecyclePanel.title: Lifecycle Assessment
lifecyclePanel.description: Health score derived from device age, connectivity, and telemetry warning breaches.
lifecyclePanel.decommissionDesc: This marks the device as retired and stops its lifecycle stage from being recomputed. This cannot be undone from here.

otaPanel.title: Firmware Update
otaPanel.description: Push a firmware build from the template's catalog and track the update's progress.
otaPanel.noFirmwareAvailable: No active firmware build registered for this device's template yet.
otaPanel.channelUnsupported: This device's push channel doesn't support OTA updates.

gatewayAutomation.title: Gateway Automation
gatewayAutomation.description: Rules the gateway itself caches and acts on, without a cloud round-trip.
gatewayAutomation.failsafeDescription: Safe state the gateway applies on its own when it can't reach the cloud.

offlineAlert.title: Alert Rules
offlineAlert.description: Notify when this gateway goes offline (no heartbeat past the offline threshold).
offlineAlert.offlineAlertDescription: Send a notification the moment this device is marked OFFLINE.
offlineAlert.noChannelsHint: No channels selected: alerts go to all your enabled channels.

unclaimedPanel.title: Unclaimed Devices
unclaimedPanel.description: Devices publishing MQTT traffic that aren't registered to any account yet. Register one to start managing it.

warningGates.noChannelsHint: No channels selected: warnings for this field go to all your enabled channels.
warningGates.title: Warning Gates
warningGates.description: Configure min/max thresholds per telemetry field and which notification channels a breach should send to.
